comparisons.name: automator-light
comparisons.description: An artwork-free stretch of Automator's gradient bottom strip, Aqua: separator rows and gradient. The last point of the 21 pt strip is outside the crop (the window's edge highlight covers it).

comparisons.name: automator-dark
comparisons.description: An artwork-free stretch of Automator's gradient bottom strip, Dark Aqua: separator rows and gradient. The last point of the 21 pt strip is outside the crop (the dark window's inner border covers it).

comparisons.name: script-editor-light
comparisons.description: An artwork-free stretch of Script Editor's flat bottom strip, Aqua: hairline and fill. The last point of the 23 pt strip is outside the crop.

comparisons.name: script-editor-dark
comparisons.description: An artwork-free stretch of Script Editor's flat bottom strip, Dark Aqua: hairline and fill. The last point of the 23 pt strip is outside the crop.

comparisons.name: system-information-light
comparisons.description: The breadcrumb strip of System Information, Aqua, whole crop: the icon is a stand-in for the application's artwork and the label is set in the fallback font.

comparisons.name: system-information-light-strip
comparisons.description: As system-information-light with the icon and the label masked, to score the strip alone.

comparisons.name: system-information-dark
comparisons.description: The breadcrumb strip of System Information, Dark Aqua, whole crop: the icon is a stand-in for the application's artwork and the label is set in the fallback font.

comparisons.name: system-information-dark-strip
comparisons.description: As system-information-dark with the icon and the label masked, to score the strip alone.

comparisons.name: long-message-light
comparisons.description: A message longer than the bar is cut and the trailing content stays inside the bar. No screenshot shows it; the pixel is the trailing swatch, which a message that is not cut pushes out of the bar.
